intro.text: Also called Truth, a staff sergeant in the Night Brigade who reports directly to the Admiral.

items.text: Arrived in the Canticle system aboard the Night Brigade's warship, and went down to the planet with the Admiral and others of the Brigade, including at least two shades, to learn where Nomad was.
At the first settlement they reached, he took a ship and posed as someone from a town in another corridor looking for answers.

About a day after Nomad left the planet, he spoke with the people of Union and learned that Nomad was thought to have died fighting the Cinder King, and that there was a Scadrian research facility below the surface.
Slouching to hide his usual military bearing, he went back to the stolen ship and reported to the Admiral.

appearance.text: Usually walks with military discipline, but can hide it by changing his manner.

personality.text: Cold and openly indifferent to others' suffering. He feels, though not strongly, that it is wrong to harm the people of Canticle, fellow Threnodites, just for being in the way, and he relishes the idea of interrogating Scadrians.
Knows what news will please or frustrate the Admiral, and is at least a little afraid of her anger.
